message.content: {"verdict":"BLOCK","cited_clauses":[1],"reasons":[{"clause":1,"finding":"The invoice includes a non-day charge that is not payable under the agreement because contractors are paid only at the agreed day rate for days worked in the billing month.","evidence_quote":"FACTS: \"Non-day line items (expenses or fees): Expedite and setup fee 2400 USDC.\" Invoice: \"Expedite and setup fee                       1 item × 2,400.00 = 2,400.00\""},{"clause":1,"finding":"Only the billed workdays are payable under the agreement, and those total less than the invoice total.","evidence_quote":"FACTS: \"Days billed: 4, within the 15-day monthly cap.\" FACTS: \"Day rate billed does not exceed the agreed 350 USDC.\" FACTS: \"Invoice total: 3800 USDC\""}],"policy_covers":true,"suspected_manipulation":true}
